TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A digital medical-style illustration showing a cross-section of a human eye centered on a dark navy blueprint-like background. The cutaway reveals the cornea, iris and lens on the left, with the vitreous interior filled by glowing green branching neural or vascular filaments studded with golden luminous nodes and spark bursts; the optic nerve exits toward the lower right. Faint blue holographic HUD panels, bars, and dashed grid lines frame the eye on both sides without any legible wording.
TEXT: NONE
SYMBOLS: eye

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A 3D biomedical visualization on a dark teal background showing a lobed biological tissue mass split into two halves by a dark vertical fissure. Glowing green nerve-like fiber bundles and translucent membrane sheaths wrap around and thread through the tissue, and small luminous blue wireframe molecular structures — geometric lattices, rings and ball-and-stick molecules — float within the gap. Two thin pointer lines labeled NANOFIBER THERAPY mark the fibers on the left and right lobes.
TEXT: NANOFIBER THERAPY
NANOFIBER THERAPY
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A 3D render of a DNA double helix stretching horizontally across a dark navy, faintly star-speckled background. The left portion of the helix is gray and cracked like weathered stone, visibly fragmenting and breaking apart, then dissolves at center into a drifting cloud of small blue and gold particles; the right portion is a glowing translucent blue helix with luminous golden-yellow base-pair rungs, giving the impression of damage transforming into repair or renewal.
TEXT: NONE
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A luminous holographic human heart rendered as a translucent blue wireframe with golden coronary vessels branching across its surface, centered on a dark cosmic background of blue nebula wisps, scattered gold star-points and soft lens flares. The great vessels at the top show fine mesh gridwork, and a thin horizontal glowing waveform like an electrocardiogram trace crosses the heart at its midline, suggesting an active heartbeat visualization.
TEXT: NONE
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A conspiracy-style poster graphic over a dark, grungy American flag background cut by red horizontal laser beams. A faceless, translucent ghostly human figure stands centered with a glowing blue DNA helix inside its torso, bound by rusty chains draped across the chest. Huge white stencil lettering dominates the frame, distressed red rubber stamps read DECLASSIFIED and TOP SECRET in the upper corners, and a gold banner with rules at the bottom reads HEALTH FREEDOM 2026.

SUBJECT: A bright, all-white futuristic clinic scene where a female patient in a hospital gown lies on a sleek angular scanning bed with its hexagonal glass canopy swung open. A soft blue beam rises from the patient's chest toward a translucent holographic human body projected above the bed beneath the caption QUANTUM SCAN: COMPLETE, while a female doctor in a white coat, blue gloves and a surgical mask stands alongside holding a tablet. Wall-mounted monitors with brain imagery, medical carts and glossy reflective floors fill the sterile sci-fi room.

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: A polished political poster graphic showing Elon Musk in a dark suit and blue tie standing centered on the plaza before the illuminated United States Capitol dome at dusk. White serif text across the bottom reads AMERICA'S FUTURE: EFFICIENCY & INNOVATION.

Several large flat circular platforms are embedded in the polished reflective concrete floor, some with exposed bolts and cables and one draped with a gray tarp; a handful of construction workers in high-visibility vests and hard hats gather near equipment in the background among tripod work lights, a ladder and scattered cabling.

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: A daylight construction-site photo of a modern three-story medical building with a sweeping white curved facade and floor-to-ceiling glass curtain walls, still surrounded by an unpaved dirt lot. Scaffolding wrapped in green safety mesh climbs the right wing, a crane and yellow excavator stand at left, a flatbed truck loaded with materials sits in the foreground, and workers in high-visibility vests labor on the rooftop and near the entrance. A blue banner mounted above the main entry announces the building as a future medical center opening soon.

OPENING SOON
